snippet.title: Origament - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
💌 Out Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3448430/Origament_A_Paper_Adventure/
Become a living letter and find your way to the one who still waits for you! Fly, sail, roll, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and travel through time and continents in this adventure platformer!😸 #indiegame 

▬ Origament: A Paper Adventure ▬▬▬▬▬
YouTube: @SpaceSauceStudio 
Discord: https://discord.gg/7UVXrWEuWW

Website: http://www.assembleteam.com/

Assemble Entertainment is an independent publisher based in Germany, best known for indie hits such as Sticky Business, Roadwarden, Decktamer, Paddle Paddle Paddle, Asgard's Fall and the Endzone franchise. Since 2016, Assemble has released more than 50 games across different genres, including cozy, horror, strategy and roguelike, and has established itself as a trusted partner for bringing original indie projects to market. #assembleentertainment
